ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_VAL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHECK_VAL IS
 pl_id ParamList; 
 V_REPORT_FILE VARCHAR2(100); 
 V_COUNT NUMBER(5); 
 X NUMBER (7);
 Y NUMBER (7);
 C_DATE DATE ;
 P_CURR_PORT_CD NUMBER;
BEGIN 
 C_DATE := HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE ;
 
 IF :P_PORT_CD IS NULL THEN
 P_CURR_PORT_CD := :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD ;
 ELSE
 P_CURR_PORT_CD := :P_PORT_CD ;
 END IF;
 
 IF :IMPR_NO IS NULL THEN
 MESSAGE('لا يمكن ترك حقل المستورد خاليا');
 MESSAGE('لا يمكن ترك حقل المستورد خاليا');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 

IF :LETTER_DIRCTION = 1 THEN
 SELECT COUNT(1) INTO V_COUNT FROM DUAL WHERE EXISTS (
 SELECT IMP.PORT_CD
 FROM
 IMPORTERS IMP,
 SD_PORTS SDP
 WHERE
 SDP.PORT_CD = IMP.PORT_CD
 AND ( IMP.IMPR_NBR = :IMPR_NO OR :IMPR_NO IS NULL)); 
 :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE := 'IMPR2141.REP';
 
ELSIF :LETTER_DIRCTION = 2 THEN
 SELECT COUNT(1) INTO V_COUNT FROM DUAL WHERE EXISTS (
 SELECT IMP.IMPR_NBR
 FROM
 IMPORTERS IMP,
SD_PORTS SDP
WHERE
(IMP.IMPR_NBR = :IMPR_NO OR :IMPR_NO IS NULL)
 AND
(SDP.PORT_CD = P_CURR_PORT_CD ));
 :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE := 'IMPR2142.REP';
 
ELSE
 SELECT COUNT(1) INTO V_COUNT FROM DUAL WHERE EXISTS (
 SELECT IMP.PORT_CD
 FROM IMPORTERS IMP, SD_PORTS SDP, SC_USERS sc
WHERE
(IMP.IMPR_NBR = :IMPR_NO OR :IMPR_NO IS NULL)AND
imp.port_cd = sdp.port_cd and
sc.port_cd =sdp.port_cd and
sc.CLASS_CD =12 
AND (SDP.PORT_CD = P_CURR_PORT_CD ));

 :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE := 'IMPR2143.REP';
 
END IF;


 
IF V_COUNT > 0 THEN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Destroy_Parameter_List( pl_id ); 
 END IF; 
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 

 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'SCREEN'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PRINTJOB',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'IMPR_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,:IMPR_NO);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_CURR_PORT_CD ',TEXT_PARAMETER,P_CURR_PORT_CD);

 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER, :REPORT_NO);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_MODULE_NAME);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'V_ORDER',TEXT_PARAMETER, :parameter.V_ORDER);
 
 
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 
 V_REPORT_FILE := :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_PATH||:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE;
 REP.Run_Product( REPORTS , V_REPORT_FILE , SYNCHRONOUS, RUNTIME , FILESYSTEM , pl_id , NULL); 


ELSE
MESSAGE('لا يوجد سجلات تحقق المطلوب');
 MESSAGE('لا يوجد سجلات تحقق المطلوب');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;

END ;

 
-------------

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE PRINT_CHECK_VAL IS

 pl_id ParamList; 
 V_REPORT_FILE VARCHAR2(100); 
 V_COUNT NUMBER(5); 
 P_PORT VARCHAR2(200);
 P_NAME VARCHAR2(200);
 X NUMBER (7);
 Y NUMBER (7);
 C_DATE DATE ;
 P_CURR_PORT_CD NUMBER;
BEGIN 
 C_DATE := HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE ;
 
 IF :P_PORT_CD IS NULL THEN
 P_CURR_PORT_CD := :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD ;
 ELSE
 P_CURR_PORT_CD := :P_PORT_CD ;
 END IF;
 
 IF :IMPR_NO IS NULL THEN
 MESSAGE('لا يمكن ترك حقل المستورد خاليا');
 MESSAGE('لا يمكن ترك حقل المستورد خاليا');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 

IF :LETTER_DIRCTION = 1 THEN
 SELECT COUNT(1) INTO V_COUNT FROM DUAL WHERE EXISTS (
 SELECT IMP.PORT_CD
 FROM
 IMPORTERS IMP,
 SD_PORTS SDP
 WHERE
 SDP.PORT_CD = IMP.PORT_CD
 AND ( IMP.IMPR_NBR = :IMPR_NO OR :IMPR_NO IS NULL)); 
 :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE := 'IMPR2141.REP';
 
ELSIF :LETTER_DIRCTION = 2 THEN
 SELECT COUNT(1) INTO V_COUNT FROM DUAL WHERE EXISTS (
 SELECT IMP.PORT_CD
 FROM
 CITIES SDC,
 IMPORTERS IMP,
 SD_PORTS SDP,
 SMPL_LABS SLC,
 SMPL_REQUESTS SR,
 SMPL_ITEMS SI
 WHERE
 ((SI.RESULT_CD IN (3,4) ) AND SI.ACTION_CD <> 1 )AND
 SI.RQST_PORT_CD = SR.RQST_PORT_CD AND
 SI.RQST_NMR = SR.RQST_NMR AND
 SI.RQST_DT = SR.RQST_DT AND
 SR.LAB_CD = SLC.LAB_CD (+) AND
 SR.RQST_PORT_CD = SDP.PORT_CD AND
 SR.RQST_PORT_CD = IMP.PORT_CD AND
 SR.IMPR_NBR = IMP.IMPR_NBR AND
 IMP.ADD_CTRY_CD = SDC.CTRY_CD AND
 IMP.CITY_CODE = SDC.CITY_CD
 AND SDP.PORT_CD = P_CURR_PORT_CD 
 AND ( IMP.IMPR_NBR = :IMPR_NO OR :IMPR_NO IS NULL)); 

 :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE := 'IMPR2142.REP';
 
ELSE
 SELECT COUNT(1) INTO V_COUNT FROM DUAL WHERE EXISTS (
 SELECT IMP.PORT_CD
 FROM IMPORTERS IMP, SD_PORTS SDP, SC_USERS sc
WHERE
(IMP.IMPR_NBR = :IMPR_NO OR :IMPR_NO IS NULL)AND
imp.port_cd = sdp.port_cd and
sc.port_cd =sdp.port_cd and
sc.CLASS_CD =12 
AND (SDP.PORT_CD = P_CURR_PORT_CD ));

 :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE := 'IMPR2143.REP';
 
END IF;

 
IF V_COUNT > 0 THEN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Destroy_Parameter_List( pl_id ); 
 END IF; 

 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PRINTJOB',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 WIN_API_DIALOG.SELECT_PRINTER(P_NAME , P_PORT , TRUE );
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'PRINTER'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DESNAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,P_NAME); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER, :REPORT_NO);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'IMPR_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,:IMPR_NO);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_CURR_PORT_CD ',TEXT_PARAMETER,P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_MODULE_NAME); 
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 
 V_REPORT_FILE := :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_PATH||:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE;
 REP.Run_Product( REPORTS , V_REPORT_FILE , SYNCHRONOUS, RUNTIME , FILESYSTEM , pl_id , NULL); 


ELSE
MESSAGE('لا يوجد سجلات تحقق المطلوب');
 MESSAGE('لا يوجد سجلات تحقق المطلوب');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 NULL;
END ;
